sources.name: Edmund Alegero
sources.quote: Getting my own place in Lake Merritt is a big deal for me. It's a step up, you know? I've been working hard, and it's nice to have a spot that's just mine. I've been following the A's news, and it's tough to see Mark Aitken leave. He's from around here, and he's always been involved in the community. But I'm trying to focus on my own game, you know? I've got my own things to work on.

sources.name: Wanjiru Liu
sources.quote: To be honest, I'm still getting used to my new place in Rockridge. As an electrician, it's not directly related to where I live, but having a stable home life helps me focus on my work. I've been keeping busy with jobs around the neighborhood and helping out when I can. The Oakland Alternative Response Initiative making waves locally is a good sign too; it feels like the community is coming together. I'm just taking things one day at a time and looking forward to continuing my work as an electrician here.

sources.name: Drago Helio
sources.quote: The win on the UNDOCKED book put a little extra cash in my pocket, and it was nice to share the story with my family over dinner. We were all talking about our weeks, and it was a good night. It didn't change my outlook, but it was a welcome surprise.

sources.name: Yu Zen
sources.quote: To be honest, losing on the UNDOCKED book stung. I'd staked 372 on it, and it didn't come through. It's not just about the money; it's the frustration. I've been working non-stop, trying to get back on my feet after my accident, and a loss like that doesn't help. It's just another thing to deal with on top of everything else.

Wanjiru Liu — Electrician — Rockridge

approvedQuotes.text: Getting my own place in Lake Merritt is a big deal for me. It's a step up, you know? I've been working hard, and it's nice to have a spot that's just mine. I've been following the A's news, and it's tough to see Mark Aitken leave. He's from around here, and he's always been involved in the community. But I'm trying to focus on my own game, you know? I've got my own things to work on.

To be honest, I'm still getting used to my new place in Rockridge. As an electrician, it's not directly related to where I live, but having a stable home life helps me focus on my work. I've been keeping busy with jobs around the neighborhood and helping out when I can. The Oakland Alternative Response Initiative making waves locally is a good sign too; it feels like the community is coming together. I'm just taking things one day at a time and looking forward to continuing my work as an electrician here.

The win on the UNDOCKED book put a little extra cash in my pocket, and it was nice to share the story with my family over dinner. We were all talking about our weeks, and it was a good night. It didn't change my outlook, but it was a welcome surprise.

To be honest, losing on the UNDOCKED book stung. I'd staked 372 on it, and it didn't come through. It's not just about the money; it's the frustration. I've been working non-stop, trying to get back on my feet after my accident, and a loss like that doesn't help. It's just another thing to deal with on top of everything else.
